Pricing

Simple, per property

One price for every property you manage in Co-Host Pro. No tiers to compare, no percentage of your bookings.

Software

AED 49

per property / month

Billed monthly for each active property in your account. Dubai (AED) and South Africa (ZAR) properties use the same rate.

  • Dubai VAT and Tourism Dirham on every booking
  • Owner statements, locked once sent, with a full activity log
  • AED and ZAR properties side by side
  • iCal calendar sync with Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo
  • Cleaning workflow, booking verification, income per property and owner portal
Get started

Good to know

  • Accounts are set up with you directly. There's no public self-serve sign-up yet.
  • The channel connection uses each listing's iCal calendar link today. See how it works.
  • Your data stays yours. You can ask for an export or deletion at any time. See Security & data.
  • We'll confirm the property count and invoice details in writing before you're charged.
